## Delivery procedure

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `DEVELOPMENT.md`, "Roadmap assignments". Read the parent and the
outcomes of the prerequisites, recheck current `main`, record a plan and the working
branch, and work test-first. The PR holds the verification evidence. Opening a PR does
not authorize merging it.

<!-- For a research assignment, replace kind:implementation with kind:research and state

     does not resolve blockers. -->
